/age: Identity of a grown specimen, not a look: only the growth path reads it, and the direct build the tuner measures is the mature tree whatever it says (crates/telperion-core/src/branching/specimen/timeline.rs:30).
/canopy/clumpNeighbours: An approximation budget: neighbours and cell crossings the clumping search may spend (crates/telperion-core/src/foliage/placement.rs:85).
/canopy/maxInstances: A hard resource cap; exceeding it is an error, never a different tree (crates/telperion-core/src/foliage/placement.rs:88).
/growth/rate: Growth-path only: `mesh::build` and `branching::generate` never read the growth traits (crates/telperion-core/src/mesh.rs:73).
/growth/resizeTolerance: Growth-path only, and an internal recording tolerance rather than a look.
/growth/workBudget: Growth-path only, and a work budget.
/skeleton/growth/influenceRadius: An unset `Option` in every shipped preset, so the wire row reads null and there is no current value to step (crates/telperion-core/src/branching.rs:72).
/skeleton/growth/killDistance: Null in every shipped preset, as above.
/skeleton/growth/maxNodes: Null in every shipped preset, and a resource cap besides.
/skeleton/growth/stepDistance: Null in every shipped preset, as above.
/skeleton/growth/trunkHeight: Null in every shipped preset, as above.
/skeleton/habit/reachProbeSteps: A sampling budget: samples spent finding an axis's room, not a look the owner can ask for (crates/telperion-core/src/branching/traits.rs:15).
/skeleton/samplingAttemptsPerAttractor: A sampling budget: it decides how hard the sampler looks for room for a pull point, not what the tree looks like (crates/telperion-core/src/envelope.rs:170).
/skeleton/seed: Identity: the seed names which tree is drawn, and the protocol fixes it. Stepping it is not a tuning move.
/skeleton/twigs/maxInternodes: A cost cap: it binds only where the two internode lengths would cut more segments (crates/telperion-core/src/twigs.rs:221).
